Hey Mary!!

I am SO excited you even responded, seriously, I’d be honored to film in your space. I actually came across one of your videos a bit ago and just want to say I really respect your candor and how you show up, it really stood out.

For a little context on me, I’ve been in the aesthetics industry for decades and have worked in pretty much every role, from front desk all the way up to managing multiple locations. I’ve spent years inside medspas and dermatology practices, so I really understand what makes a space not just look beautiful, but actually function at a high level.

For next Thursday, I’d love to learn a little more about your locations so I can prep everything properly on my end. Would you mind sending over some photos or a quick walkthrough video of the space? That will help me align with my production team and make sure we capture everything in the best way possible.

Also, if you happen to have any shot ideas, signature areas, or “must-capture” moments inside your medspa, I’d love to see or hear those too so we can highlight what makes your space special.

Once I take a look at everything, I’d love to jump on a quick call with you to chat through details and make sure we’re aligned before Thursday.

Really looking forward to connecting more and seeing if this is a great fit for both of us. I have a feeling it will be 😊
